messages.subject: Feedback on Tennis Simulation App
parts:
Hello everyone! I just finished making my first webapp with Shiny, and first webapp ever. Here's the link. It uses Highcharts, and I used Winston Chang's dashboard app to help me out.

Basically, you input a probability of winning individual points, and the app simulates tennis matches and outputs the percentage of points, games, tiebreakers, sets, and matches that are won. It's really interesting to see how small of a point advantage you need to basically guarantee winning the match.

I hope to eventually use rCharts; I just wasn't sure if rCharts had the ability to dynamically update charts. Does anybody have any suggestions or comments?

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Feedback on Tennis Simulation App
parts:
The app looks great Chirag!

rCharts does have the ability to dynamically update charts. Currently, it is a pseudo-update in the sense that it redraws the entire graph. Since it is just text output, it works well.

We are planning to update rCharts to take advantage of updating only the incoming data, like what is done by Winston's dashboard app.

Hope this helps.

Best,
Ramnath
